intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“偏远地点 -> 被遗忘 -> 意外重新发现 -> 值得抢救 -> 安排修复 -> 蜜蜂蜂蜡惊喜”的故事线跟读。重点读清 location phrase、passive rediscovery、worth rescuing、have something done，以及最后 sweet as honey 的惊喜语气。

sentences.text: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island, a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一九六三年，一架 Lancaster bomber 坠毁在南太平洋的 Wallis Island。注意 Wallis Island 后面的 a remote place... 是补充说明，读出地点层层展开。

sentences.text: The plane wasn't too badly damaged, but over the years, the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：飞机损坏不算太严重，但多年以后事故被遗忘，残骸没有被打扰。but 后读出转折，was forgotten 和 remained undisturbed 是重点。

sentences.text: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一九八九年，也就是失事二十六年后，飞机在航空勘查中被意外重新发现。时间插入语要稳，accidentally rediscovered 是核心动作。

sentences.text: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：到了那时，状态还算不错的 Lancaster bomber 已经很稀有，值得抢救。By this time 先轻停，worth rescuing 要读出价值判断。

sentences.text: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：法国方面安排人把飞机拆分包装并运回法国。had the plane packaged and moved 是 have something done 结构。

sentences.text: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一群爱好者准备请人修复这架飞机。enthusiasts 要读清楚；have the plane restored 也是安排别人做事。

sentences.text: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey -- still in perfect condition.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：打开包装箱时，他们惊喜地发现第四台发动机像蜂蜜一样甜，而且完好无损。Imagine 开头要有惊喜感，sweet as honey 是标题笑点。

sentences.text: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一群蜜蜂把发动机变成蜂房，发动机被蜂蜡完整保存。colony、hive、beeswax 三个词读清，句尾带一点发现谜底的惊喜。
focus_words: turned the engine into a hive
